items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: He had Penn playing drums with him but I don't know who he got playing drums with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. I don't know who he got playing drum after Penn died there. He had Penn playing drums with him but I don't know who he got playing drums with him. Next time he come here, my eyes, he'll be always coming by you every once in a while.
Listen, where was the Turtle Back Hall? Huh? Where was the Turtle Back Hall?
